reef.definition: A ridge in the sea made of coral or rock.

librarians.definition: People who look after books and help readers in a library.

dawn.definition: The time when daylight first appears.

daybreak.definition: The time when the sun begins to light the sky.

mini-sub.definition: A small vehicle that travels underwater.

coral.definition: A small sea animal that helps form hard, colorful reefs.

octopus.definition: A sea animal with a soft body and eight arms.

hammerhead.definition: A shark with a wide head shaped like a hammer.

dolphins.definition: Sea mammals that breathe air and swim using flippers and a tail.

dolphin.definition: A sea mammal that breathes air and has a curved mouth.

surface.definition: The top layer of the water.

backpack.definition: A bag carried on your back.

research.definition: Information collected by studying a subject.

pearl.definition: A smooth, round object formed inside some shellfish.

calm.definition: A peaceful state without panic or strong excitement.

climbed.definition: Moved upward using hands and feet.

stared.definition: Looked at something for a long time.

exclaimed.definition: Said something suddenly with strong feeling.

ladder.definition: A frame with steps used for climbing.

magical.definition: Having or seeming to have special powers.

ocean.definition: A very large area of salt water.

breath.definition: The air taken into or sent out of your lungs.

fins.definition: Flat body parts that help a fish swim.

tentacles.definition: Long, flexible body parts used to feel or hold things.

suckers.definition: Small cup-shaped parts that grip a surface.

crack.definition: A narrow break in a hard surface.

leak.definition: An opening that lets liquid pass through.

hatch.definition: A small door or opening in a vehicle.

controls.definition: Parts used to operate a machine.

button.definition: A small part pressed to make a machine work.

failed.definition: Did not succeed in doing something.

riddle.definition: A puzzling question with a hidden answer.

notebook.definition: A book of blank pages used for writing notes.

pointed.definition: Showed a direction with a finger or another object.

floated.definition: Stayed on or moved gently through water without sinking.
